peoples_entry.name: Iron Republic
peoples_entry.note: Highland citizen-army republic born of the Third Legion mutiny at Roketstad (Six Cantonal Tings R1-R6): Imperial-Russian/Red-Army shinel & telogreika uniforms, Muscovite Streltsy & Pike-and-Shot cuirassiers, Transylvanian-Saxon & Novgorodian guilds/feast dress, and Footfall/Cascade/Roketstad industrial salvage (21 tiers at 100% M+F parity; tools/garments/cultures/iron_republic_full.py).
